capabilities: hide empty folders that contain no relevant file type below them
hide folders matching gitignore-style ignore patterns
pin individual folders to always show or always hide
toggle revealing all hidden folders for the session
optionally write pattern-hidden folders into Obsidian Sync's excluded folders
extras: Distributed via the AnySource Sideloader catalog rather than the standard plugin store; detailed documentation and troubleshooting live on a separate docs site; folders stay visible on iOS below 16.4.
problem: Opening a vault full of code repositories floods the file explorer with node_modules, build output, and folders that never held a note, with no way to hide them short of deleting them.

relations.evidence: an opt-in switch writes the folders hidden by a pattern or an "always hide" pin into Obsidian Sync's excluded folders

summary: File-explorer filter that hides empty and irrelevant folders without deleting them, using gitignore-style patterns, per-folder pins, and optional Sync exclusion.
